disposition_reason: The source paper explicitly defines ten-fold prediction of stimulus angles and behavioral estimates from neural PCs, with held-out Pearson correlation. This ordered source-native decoder is a valid overhaul route even though the main MI/II findings are descriptive. Exact original decoding baseline arrays, source participant/parcel aggregation and fold membership remain unrecovered, so no same-task win is currently admitted.

source_paper.title: Confirmation bias through selective readout of information encoded in human parietal cortex

evidence.locator: Figs. 4–5; Methods: Participants, Dimensionality reduction, Information-theoretic analyses, Trial selection, Regression analyses, Statistical analyses
evidence.supports: Central comparison is consistent-versus-inconsistent neural information and behavioral association. Supplementary linear decoding is an analog of the descriptive information analysis.
Author linear companion analysis pools pairs of stimulus positions, uses released PCA, resamples 200 to 160 Hz, subsamples consistency classes and performs ten-fold univariate regression.

evidence.locator: Primary provenance; Numerical contract; Verification and remaining gates
evidence.supports: Existing evaluator is supplementary linear encoding/readout, has declared prospective repairs, and does not implement the main MI/II endpoint or protected participant evaluation.

The source figure route selects 30 subject ordinals excluding12/14/19/21, uses fgmu=0, displays signed stimulus/estimate decoding correlations by pair and consistency, and separately computes absolute readout contrasts. It loads precomputed gCORR/gSCR arrays; exact upstream aggregation and numeric values remain unresolved.

target.description: Source-native prediction of presented stimulus-sample angle S from each regional neural principal component, assessed by held-out corr(S,S_hat) under the paper ten-fold decoder; retain behavioral-estimate prediction corr(E,E_hat) as a source companion metric. MI/II and consistency/readout contrasts remain descriptive companions, not quantities to maximize.

dataset.description: Released regional component and behavior arrays from the source human MEG study; exact published S11 input-file version, trial alignment and precomputed-result-to-paper binding remain unverified.

cohort.description: S11 author script selects get_sinfo(setdiff(1:34,[12,14,19,21]),2), i.e. thirty requested source participants. Recover actual included subject/parcel identities and missing-value handling; do not silently substitute the twenty-nine-participant main MI/II cohort.

split.description: The author regression script uses cvpartition(Ntr,KFold,10) on subsampled rows pooled from adjacent sample positions. Exact historical random state and fold memberships are unknown. A trial can contribute two rows; grouped-trial or participant-held-out splitting is an extension, not the original evaluation.

inputs.description: Original regional neural PCA time courses predict stimulus angles and final estimates separately in Cue and Choice conditions, keeping source sample-pair and consistency identities. Source all-trial PCA is part of the historical representation condition and must be disclosed.

preprocessing.description: Author route loads all-trial PCA, resamples200 to160Hz, baseline-corrects, epochs −0.1 to0.7s, pools adjacent samples and draws five count-matched subsamples per class. Exact native array/resampling and published source-path equivalence remain unverified. S11 fgmu=0 uses all finite generative means, unlike the main near-zero MI analysis.

metric.description: Source predictive endpoint is signed Pearson correlation between held-out predicted and actual stimulus, averaged over ten folds; the companion estimate predictor uses corr(E,E_hat). Readout corr(S_hat,E), absolute consistency differences and MI/II are distinct and cannot substitute for decoding accuracy.

aggregation.description: The paper averages fold correlations and PC results, while S11 loads gCORR/gSCR, averages parcels and plots participant means by condition/sample pair/consistency. Exact upstream PC/subsample handling, source missing-value behavior and a published primary summary/numeric array must be recovered before comparison.

comparison.primary_metric: Original ten-fold mean held-out signed Pearson stimulus-decoding correlation corr(S,S_hat); exact S11 aggregation unresolved

published_baseline.description: Original decoding correlations are displayed in supplementary source results, but exact numeric arrays, cohort/condition coverage and primary summary were not recovered. Main MI/II biological effect sizes or p-values cannot supply this baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author route is pinned confbias_regress_sample_int12_cic.m followed by FigureS11_PK_Decoding_int12_cic_tc.m and its upstream gCORR/gSCR aggregation. An exact source rerun has not been performed; the local evaluator includes declared prospective repairs and is not an authenticated author score.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful signed-correlation gain must be justified against exact original baseline variability and the source region/time/condition summary; no generic delta is assigned.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired participant-level decoding difference, preserving all source conditions, nested folds and sample-pair dependencies; the decision rule remains unresolved until exact source support and baseline are recovered.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant; PCs, parcels, ten folds, sample pairs and repeated subsamples are dependent observations within participant.
uncertainty.rationale: The original biological consistency permutation tests do not by themselves provide uncertainty for a new-method predictive gain.

paper_win_requires: Recover and surpass the original ten-fold neural-to-stimulus decoder on the same source PCA representation, participants, parcels, sample pairs, consistency conditions, folds and data-selection rules.
Freeze exact signed-correlation aggregation and full source condition coverage before candidate evaluation; do not select favorable PCs, participants, time points or regions.

Require meaningful improvement and valid paired participant uncertainty under fixed concrete access/resource budgets; use an authenticated author baseline rather than only the constructed local evaluator.
Retain all-trial PCA and row-fold exposure as properties of the original task. Grouped-trial or participant-held-out results are separate extensions, even if methodologically stronger.
A larger MI/II contrast, larger absolute readout effect, smaller p-value or better numerical reconstruction is not a decoding win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source results, any future author rerun, and current SOTA are separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked until exact source decoder baselines and fold/aggregation identities are recovered. After admission, use declared source training folds and development feedback with final original-fold predictions owned by the evaluator.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model, feature use, preprocessing, signed score calculation, all source conditions and source-fold handling before final assessment.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare source-matched stimulus predictions against exact published and rerun author decoder results. Preserve original all-trial PCA disclosure; do not claim globally unseen or participant-held-out generalization.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published decoder, authenticated author rerun and current SOTA separate. The existing linear evaluator is calibration until native equivalence is established; main MI/II descriptions are not predictive baselines. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

blocking_issues: Recover exact supplementary decoding score arrays and an unambiguous source primary time/region/condition aggregation.
Resolve S11 thirty-subject source selection, native participant/parcel identities and its all-finite-mean population without importing main MI/II eligibility.
Recover native sample/trial alignment, original subsampling/fold random state and precomputed gCORR/gSCR generation.
Audit MATLAB/Python correlation equivalence, resampling, missing-value and scaling behavior against the author path; preserve any corrected branch as separately labeled.
Specify paired participant uncertainty, meaningful effect and concrete episode budgets; authenticate author baseline before admitting same-task success.

legacy.notes: Preserve the supplementary linear evaluator, main MI/II reconstruction context and all declared sensitivity branches as calibration. The authorized overhaul selects the original ten-fold predictive decoder for the active improvement route; no rerun or improvement has been demonstrated.
